auth.v1.AuthErrorCode.description: High-level error codes for authentication and account-domain failures.
auth.v1.AuthErrorCode.title: AuthErrorCode

auth.v1.GetSocialVerificationResponse.description:
GetSocialVerificationResponse contains the caller's current social
 verification state for one provider. A successful response with verification
 absent means the caller has not started verification for that provider.

verification.description:
Current verification state for the requested provider. Absent when no
 verification has been started.
verification.title: verification

auth.v1.GetSocialVerificationResponse.title: GetSocialVerificationResponse

auth.v1.SocialProvider.description: Social account provider used for account ownership verification.
auth.v1.SocialProvider.title: SocialProvider

auth.v1.SocialVerification.description:
SocialVerification describes the caller's current verification state for one
 social provider.

attempts.description: Number of recorded provider-check attempts for this challenge.
attempts.title: attempts

challengeCode.description:
Challenge code the user must submit according to the verification method.
 Discord codes are returned only when a challenge is issued. Codes expire
 after 15 minutes.
challengeCode.title: challenge_code

errorCode.description:
Stable machine-readable error code for the current failed verification.
 AUTH_UNSPECIFIED when no typed error applies.
errorCode.title: error_code

expiresAt.description: Time in UTC when the current challenge code expires.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

handle.description:
Provider handle being verified. Handles are returned lowercase and without
 a leading "@".
handle.title: handle

lastError.description:
Last verification error, if the most recent check failed. Empty when there
 is no recorded error.
lastError.title: last_error

method.description:
Method used for this verification. If unspecified at start time, the
 provider default is used.
method.title: method

providerUserId.description: Stable provider-side user identifier. Empty until verification succeeds.
providerUserId.title: provider_user_id

requestedAt.description: Time in UTC when the current challenge code was issued.
requestedAt.title: requested_at

updatedAt.description: Time in UTC when this verification state last changed.
updatedAt.title: updated_at

verifiedAt.description: Time in UTC when verification succeeded. Empty until status is STATUS_VERIFIED.
verifiedAt.title: verified_at

auth.v1.SocialVerification.title: SocialVerification

auth.v1.SocialVerificationMethod.description: How the user proves control of the provider account.
auth.v1.SocialVerificationMethod.title: SocialVerificationMethod

auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyRequest.description:
SocialVerificationReadyRequest tells the API that the challenge code has been
 placed and the provider account is ready to check.
auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyRequest.title: SocialVerificationReadyRequest

auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyResponse.description:
SocialVerificationReadyResponse returns the verification after it has been
 queued for a provider check.

verification.description: Current verification state after the provider check was requested.
verification.title: verification

auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyResponse.title: SocialVerificationReadyResponse

auth.v1.SocialVerificationStatus.description: Current state of a social account verification attempt.
auth.v1.SocialVerificationStatus.title: SocialVerificationStatus

auth.v1.StartSocialVerificationRequest.description:
StartSocialVerificationRequest starts or restarts social account verification.
 Starting again for the same provider replaces the previous challenge.
discord_channel_method // discord verification uses the channel method
discord_handle_omitted // discord verification does not accept a handle
twitter_handle_format // twitter handle must be 1-15 chars [A-Za-z0-9_], optionally prefixed with '@'

handle.description:
Provider handle the user claims. Required for X/Twitter and omitted for
 Discord, where the authenticated bot supplies the provider identity.
 A leading "@" is accepted and removed from X/Twitter handles.
handle.no_angle_brackets // handle must not contain '<' or '>'
handle.title: handle

method.description:
Verification method. If unspecified, profile verification is used for
 X/Twitter and channel verification is used for Discord.
method.title: method

auth.v1.StartSocialVerificationRequest.title: StartSocialVerificationRequest

auth.v1.StartSocialVerificationResponse.description: Response returned after starting social account verification.

Newly issued challenge code the user must submit according to the
 verification method.
challengeCode.title: challenge_code

expiresAt.description:
Time in UTC when the challenge code expires. Social verification challenges
 expire after 15 minutes.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

verification.description: Current verification state after issuing the challenge.
verification.title: verification

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.
